apps.name: Bondfather
apps.subtitle: Estonian IPO tracker
apps.localizedDescription: Tracks upcoming Estonian public offerings from NASDAQ Baltic and sends daily notifications when new offerings appear.

permissions.usageDescription: Included in all development-signed apps; allows a debugger to attach.

versions.localizedDescription: Issuer insights now use Gemini 4 Hydrogen, with Gemini 3.8 Flash as a fallback. A new offering from a company you've already been alerted about now gets its own alert. When an insights refresh fails, the previous insights and the AI disclaimer stay on screen. After updating, re-save your Gemini API key in Settings once so the morning check can fetch insights while your phone is locked.

Adds bond detail screen with ISIN, pricing, and settlement info; shows interest rate in the list; enriches each issuer with AI-generated sector, business summary, and risk indicators (bring your own Gemini API key in Settings).
